actual: The Batch B materialization CLI reads only TDX_DB_* and the shared runtime roots from --env-file. The mandatory DEV-first materialization cannot select TDX_DB_DEV_* without manually generating a secret-bearing remapped env file. Add an explicit, typed DEV target path that derives DEV Historical Range roots only from the existing explicit repo-external --artifact-root, preserves production defaults, and fails visibly on incomplete configuration. Do not add DDL, manual approvals, package re-admission, Selection/Paper/simulation changes, or silent fallback.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
